title: Lesyn: Placement-aware Logic Resynthesis for Non-Integer Multiple-Cell-Height Designs
problem: Non-integer multiple cell height (NIMCH) standard-cell libraries require layout constraints where sub-regions can only accommodate gates of the same height, but conventional physical design flows cluster and relocate gates to satisfy these constraints, causing substantial gate displacement and performance degradation.
motivation: NIMCH standard-cell libraries enable co-optimization of power, performance and area in advanced technology nodes, making constraint-aware optimization critical.
method: The method chooses which standard-cell height variant to use for each gate after the initial placement phase, without moving gates to different positions. Standard cells come in multiple physical heights; the approach selects variants such that neighboring gates have compatible heights, satisfying the NIMCH constraint that layout regions must contain only gates of the same height. This preserves the original gate positions and avoids the performance loss that occurs when conventional design flows relocate gates to satisfy these height constraints.
key_novelty: Selecting standard-cell height variants after placement to satisfy NIMCH constraints without relocating gates.
contributions: Placement-aware logic resynthesis methodology for NIMCH standard-cell designs
Row-based cell height adjustment strategy that preserves gate placement locality
26.1% reduction in maximal delay compared to conventional NIMCH physical design flow
Co-optimization framework balancing NIMCH layout constraints with circuit performance
primary_theme: Placement-aware resynthesis for NIMCH standard cells
